exact.proof: Imaginary magnitude lower bound exceeds the complete truncation error bound

structure.reason: Global phases do not certify a Hermitian sandwich

hermiticity.criterion: Exact structure OR max_P |Im(c_tilde_P)| + eta < delta; missing coefficients bounded by eta

alpha_policy: Infer alpha, choose a concrete decimal candidate, recompute the residual
acceptance_rule: (Exact structure OR max_P |Im(c_tilde_P)|+eta < delta) AND alpha>0 AND 2^(n/2)*||alpha*c_tilde-h||_2 + alpha*eta <= epsilon_BE

pennylane_ccx.method: Exact computational-basis evaluation; no numerical tolerance

local_summaries.decimal_rotations: Retained exactly as parsed; only exact-zero rotations removed

bounded_pruning.norm: Operator norm on the complete ancilla branch column, then projected block
bounded_pruning.rule: Charge sum abs_upper(c) for discarded terms and sum (Re radius + Im radius) for recentered terms, over ALL branches
bounded_pruning.propagation: Unitary suffixes preserve operator norm; final projection and restored global phase do not increase it
bounded_pruning.budget_policy: Keep the entire batch if its upper bound would exceed the budget
bounded_pruning.interval_roundoff: Recenter to exact dyadic midpoints only after charging the complete ball radii; preserve balls if the shared budget would be exceeded

coefficient_scope: Sparse approximate block B_tilde; ||B_original-B_tilde|| <= eta (pruning plus charged recentering)
core_proportionality_scope: Fit/check on B_tilde only; final proportionality_pass also includes alpha*eta
